WITH sample AS (
  SELECT
    tn.id AS niche_id,
    c.purchase_number,
    c.price AS contract_price,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY tn.id ORDER BY c.published_at DESC) AS rn
  FROM target_niches tn
  JOIN contracts c ON c.region_code = tn.region_code
  JOIN unnest(c.ktru) AS k(code) ON k.code = tn.ktru_code
  LEFT JOIN dumping_checks dc ON dc.purchase_number = c.purchase_number
  WHERE tn.status = 'pending'
    AND tn.avg_dumping IS NULL
    AND c.purchase_number IS NOT NULL
    AND c.price BETWEEN 10000 AND 200000
    AND c.published_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '12 months'
    AND dc.purchase_number IS NULL
)
SELECT niche_id::text, purchase_number, contract_price::text
FROM sample
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY niche_id
LIMIT 20;

WITH agg AS (
  SELECT
    niche_id,
    ROUND(AVG(dumping_pct)::numeric, 1) AS avg_dump,
    COUNT(*) AS samples
  FROM dumping_checks
  WHERE max_price > 0
  GROUP BY niche_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
)
UPDATE target_niches tn SET
  avg_dumping = a.avg_dump,
  status = CASE
    WHEN a.avg_dump > 25 THEN 'risky'
    ELSE tn.status
  END
FROM agg a
WHERE tn.id = a.niche_id
  AND tn.status = 'pending'
RETURNING tn.id, tn.region_code::text, tn.ktru_code,
          tn.avg_dumping::text, tn.status;
